applies_to: List group papers, Nature (asymmetric organocatalysis, IDPi catalysts)

signature_features: catalyst and reagent above the arrow; solvent with molarity, temperature and time below, e.g. 'Toluene (0.2 M)' over 'T (°C), 24 h'
product label with yield and e.r. stacked below it, e.g. '6, 91%' then '98:2 e.r.' (crop 02); crop 03 sets the label alone on one line and yield and e.r. on the next
catalyst aryl variants 2 to 5 drawn with a blue #456A98 dot above and a gold #DEC27D dot below (crop 02)
light teal #CCE6E6 disc behind the key product in overview figures (crop 01)

notes.yield_placement: not set: no two crops agree. Crop 01 stacks yield and d.r./e.r. to the right of the product; crop 02 puts the yield on the label line ('6, 91%'); crop 03 puts the label alone with yield and e.r. on the next line.
notes.yield_format: '{value}%' from crops 02 and 03 (bare percentages on scope labels). Crop 01 writes '{value}% yield'; that value is set in figure_types.reaction_scheme.
notes.substrate_layout: only one-component schemes in the crops
notes.abbreviate_groups: CF3 (crops 02, 04) and TMS (crops 02, 04, 06) meet the two-crop rule. One-crop groups are not set here: tBu (crop 03), OMe (crop 02), OBn (crop 03), CN (crop 02), TBSO (crop 02). nHex (crop 05) and C2F5 (crop 02) are not in the abbreviation table; OTMS in crop 02 reads through TMS.
notes.highlight_fill: no agreement at top level: teal #CCE6E6 disc in crop 01; grey background panels in crop 03 (#F0F0F0 behind the scheme, #F7F7F7 behind the catalyst). Grey highlight fills are set per section: #EFEFEF in mechanism (crop 04), #F9F9F9 in catalytic_cycle (crop 05).
notes.catalyst_arc_colour: steel-blue #457898 in crops 04 and 06; black in crops 03 and 05. Not a top-level feature; see figure_types.
notes.compound_label_color: #000000 for scheme compounds (crops 02, 03). Energy-profile species labels are navy (crop 07), recorded in figure_types.energy_profile signature features; that section has no compound-label colour key.

evidence.citation: List et al., Nature 2023 (Catalytic asymmetric synthesis of cannabinoids and menthol from neral)
evidence.observations: grey disc with teal #CCE6E6 inner disc around the product, curved text on the disc, teal block arrows to boxed applications with grey title strips; catalysis as a teal ring arrow, 3D TS in brackets with double dagger, '76% yield / d.r. > 20:1 / e.r. = 99:1' stacked right of the product

evidence.citation: List et al., Nature 2022 (Organocatalytic stereoselective cyanosilylation of small ketones)
evidence.observations: measured on the 2078 px figure; scope grid with thin grey rules and centred category titles, bold label with yield then e.r., catalyst substituents as blue #456A98 and gold #DEC27D dots

evidence.citation: List et al., Nature 2024 (Catalytic asymmetric cationic shifts of aliphatic hydrocarbons)
evidence.observations: scope grid under grey header bands (#F0F0F0 behind the scheme, #F7F7F7 behind the catalyst), bold labels with '93%, 97.5:2.5 e.r.', X-ray structures beside derivatisations

evidence.citation: List et al., Nature 2022 (Organocatalytic stereoselective cyanosilylation of small ketones)
evidence.observations: computed mechanism: TSs in square brackets with double dagger, bold labels (TS0, INT1) with free energies in blue #0000FF in parentheses, H-bonds dashed, products in purple #800080, red cross on the disfavoured arrow

evidence.citation: List et al., Nature 2024 (Catalytic asymmetric cationic shifts of aliphatic hydrocarbons)
evidence.observations: catalytic cycle of large black arcs, step names (Protonation, Deprotonation, Ring expansion) in plain text, bracketed intermediates with bold roman labels I-IV, 13C label in red, carbons marked by lavender #8080BE and teal #408080 dots

evidence.citation: List et al., Nature 2022 (Organocatalytic stereoselective cyanosilylation of small ketones)
evidence.observations: cycle with the IDPi catalyst drawn at top and left, step names on grey boxes (Silylation, Ketone activation, Asymmetric cyanation), equilibrium half-arrows, steel-blue #457898 backbone arcs

evidence.citation: List et al., Nature 2023 (Catalytic asymmetric synthesis of cannabinoids and menthol from neral)
evidence.observations: free energy (kcal mol-1) vs reaction coordinate, short thick black bars joined by dashed lines, bold navy #000086 labels above and values below each bar, 3D TS inset with a grey magnifier ring

signature_features: yield, d.r. and e.r. stacked to the right of the product: '76% yield', 'd.r. > 20:1', 'e.r. = 99:1'
teal #CCE6E6 disc behind the key product, inside a grey #ECECEC backing around the overview scheme
reaction_scheme.notes: one crop (crop 01); the yield format, the teal disc and the grey backing are read from that single unambiguous crop. The section value overrides the top-level yield format.

signature_features: bold number centred under the structure; yield and e.r. on the lines below (crop 02: yield on the label line, '6, 91%', then e.r.; crop 03: label alone, then yield and e.r. on one line)
category titles centred between thin grey horizontal rules, e.g. 'Aliphatic ketones' (crop 02); crop 03 has a left-aligned plain title and no rules
footnote letters as superscripts after the yield (crop 02) or on the compound label (crop 03, 3k^a)
substrate_scope.notes: both crops agree on the e.r. format ('{value} e.r.'). highlight_fill stays null: the grey panel in crop 03 is a two-tone background (#F0F0F0 behind the scheme, #F7F7F7 behind the catalyst), not a highlight, and crop 02 has none.

signature_features: TSs in square brackets with a double dagger at top right
free energies in blue #0000FF in parentheses after bold labels
hydrogen bonds as dashed black lines
products in purple #800080, disfavoured path marked with a red cross
IDPi catalyst drawn with steel-blue #457898 backbone arcs; no substituent dots in this crop
mechanism.notes: computed mechanism without curved arrows (crop 04, one crop). Grey #EFEFEF highlight boxes sit behind the ketone at the TS1 and TS1' positions. Labels are bold prefix plus number (TS0, INT1, TS1', INT2); the schema has no bold alphanumeric value, so bold_number is the nearest and this is a schema limit.

signature_features: large black arcs; substrates enter and products leave on short curved arrows
step names in plain text, on grey boxes (#E7E7E7) in crop 06
catalyst drawn schematically; backbone arcs steel-blue #457898 in crop 06 but black in crop 05
bracketed intermediates with bold roman labels I-IV (crop 05)
catalytic_cycle.notes: roman labels in crop 05 only. catalyst_color is left unset because the two crops disagree (crop 06 steel-blue, crop 05 black). highlight_fill #F9F9F9 is the grey box behind intermediate II in crop 05 (one crop); the crop 06 step-name boxes are #E7E7E7 label backgrounds and are not set here.

signature_features: short thick black bars joined by thin dashed lines
bold navy #000086 species labels above, values below each bar
y axis 'Free energy (kcal mol-1)', x axis 'Reaction coordinate'
energy_profile.notes: one crop (crop 07). energy_label is left unset: the y axis reads 'Free energy (kcal mol-1)' and the species values carry no delta symbol, and the schema has no value for an unlabelled energy.
